### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **32** documentable anchor(s).

**29** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 38 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1a7ebc6e875a2f266885c0eb9e33746d52d3cd6c` — the merge of head `927957df4e375e0d7c338d7e63e859335b643d3c` into base `fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1a7ebc6e875a2f266885c0eb9e33746d52d3cd6c && git checkout 1a7ebc6e875a2f266885c0eb9e33746d52d3cd6c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d 927957df4e375e0d7c338d7e63e859335b643d3c && git checkout -B drift-repro fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d && git merge --no-ff 927957df4e375e0d7c338d7e63e859335b643d3c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `08ebcd01dcc490e4c7948be77e9c50ff2d1b4c7c`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card #20462 body and all four comments (triage 5873680175, claim 5875144601, os-dev-report 5875946281, amended claim 5875978969); PR #20490 body, its 13-file list and the net diff against merge-base `851af0c27` (read-only `git fetch`, `git show`, `git diff`); the check-runs on the head, read twice (first read: 12 in progress; final read 2026-09-28T18:35:07Z, below); PR #20485 metadata and its patches on the three shared ledgers. objectui `packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` read for the console words. The four locale bundles and the provenance table were parsed from blobs in scratch (python over `git show` output). No worktree, checkout, build, test, gate or ablation.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Bundle `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`: 320 leaf values change, 0 keys. Key set identical to `en` and unchanged from base to head (1529 leaves each, measured). Every changed leaf was byte-equal to `en` at base, none is at head, every new value carries Han. RIGHT: leaf values only, as the claim requires; `check:i18n` is green on the head (Lint & Repo Gates).
2. Provenance companion `zh-CN.source-hashes.generated.ts`: −320 rows, +0, 42 left, rows sorted. At base and at head every row's digest equals `hashSource(en leaf)` under the repo's own FNV-1a-plus-finalizer (`source-hash.ts`), recomputed in scratch (`hashSource("ID")` = `00b0385c9c152888`, as the file shows); rows equal the byte-copies at both revisions (362 and 42); the 320 dropped rows are exactly the 320 changed leaves. RIGHT: a faithful `pnpm i18n:extract` output, no hand edit detectable.
3. The 42 echoes, each judged. 7 sign-in brands (Google … Discord): right. 23 bare `ID` labels: the bundle keeps ID inside 用户 ID / 团队 ID / 客户端 ID, and a noun-less ID has nothing to render; right. `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`: protocol names, and their `help` leaves are translated (rows 72–73 of the diff); right. `IdP SSO URL`: right (siblings authored IdP 实体 ID / IdP 签名证书). Four placeholders (`openid email profile`, `email`, `name`, the SAML NameID URN): typed literals the admin types; right. `Message-ID`: RFC 5322 header name; right. `UI` / `API`: initialisms; right. Result-dialog `Client ID` / `Client Secret`: defensible and disclosed — the same dialog family authors `我已保存 Client Secret` and `新的 Client Secret` verbatim (both present in the bundle), so the one-time credential dialog keeps the names. It is the one place `Client ID` reads English while seven field labels read 客户端 ID; a judgment the maintainer can flip in one row. No ordinary label hides among the 42: the set is equal to the provenance rows and to the measured copies, checked three ways.
4. Ledger `objects-zh-cn-echo-decisions.test.ts`: the family shape (`Verdict = 'translate' | 'echo'`, a reason per row, a `departure` per echo, `undeclaredEchoes` — present in ten sibling ledgers), no new mechanism. It pins the three reproduced leaves as translated with Han, pins role-option equality between `sys_member` and `sys_invitation` with distinct Han words, and pins every echo to its provenance row; `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*`, so it is in the test type-check program. RIGHT. Two comment-accuracy nits, non-blocking: the header says the table "kept exactly the 42 below; asserted", while the tests assert echoes ⊆ table and translate-rows ∉ table, not table ⊆ echoes (by design, per the PR's own "does not assert" paragraph; the equality is measured true at head); and the PR body names `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` as the first ledger with `undeclaredEchoes`, while that file has `Verdict` and the predicate arrives in the later rounds.
5. Translations: all 320 changed leaves were read, not a sample, including every `options.*` value (managed_by admin / package / platform, delegated_admin on both objects, lock_state no-delete / no-overlay, severity critical / info / warning, type web) and every leaf on sys_member, sys_invitation, sys_team, sys_team_member, sys_session and sys_two_factor. No mistranslation found. Consistency was measured mechanically: grouping all 1529 leaves by en value, the head renders an en value two ways in only two cases that involve a changed leaf, both disclosed — `Client ID` (above) and `Locked Until` (锁定至 on sys_user and sys_two_factor vs the pre-existing 锁定到 on sys_job_queue); 33 such pairs already exist at base and this PR adds none. Terms follow in-bundle precedent: 预配 (1 to 21), 下线 (0 to 10), 通道 (0 to 7), 范围 for scopes (matches four existing labels), 启用 for Active (all eight agree), 过期时间 (all ten agree), 创建时间 / 更新时间 (44 / 30 agree), 上级组织 (existing), 管理方 with 平台 / 包 / 管理员 (sys_metadata's words), 严重程度 / 去重键 / 负载 / 主题 (present in service-messaging's zh-CN bundle), 我的组织 (the hand-authored `zh-CN.ts:22` nav_account_memberships label), Web 应用 (the sibling option), and sys_migration's ASCII punctuation (11 precedents in that section). objectui agreement: `zh.ts:2800` `delegatedAdmin: '受托管理员'`, roles 所有者 / 管理员 / 成员, 岗位 for positions, 业务单元, 过期时间. Stylistic nits only: `Last Login At` was 最近登录时间 while the new `Last Activity At` is 最后活动时间 (different en terms, so not a two-way rendering); the new emptyState uses 你 where the bundle already mixes 你 (4) and 您 (8).
6. The nine panel ledgers: every hunk is one floor line plus a two-line comment, and the TTL near-twin. The old floors (greater than 100 / 300 provenance rows, greater than 50 echoing objects leaves) pinned the old copy debt — each fails at 42, as the dev's pre-fix run reported (15 failures across 9 files). The new floors are greater than 0 with the same message ("provenance table is empty" / "has no echoing objects leaf to sample"): still a real lit-check an empty import cannot pass, and every assertion that follows (`stillFilled` equals [], `metadataFormRows` equals [], every echoing leaf has a row) keeps full strength; the paired `authored.length` greater-than-50 floors are untouched. The loop runs over all three locales, so ja-JP / es-ES (383 / 392 rows) also drop to greater than 0 — exactly what the amended claim authorises ("each floor becomes non-emptiness") and nothing beyond it. TTL near-twin: zh-CN is now asserted authored (not equal to en, carries `TTL` via `carriesToken`, defined at line 851, no provenance row); ja-JP / es-ES keep the fill assertion. It reads true against the head (leaf 访问令牌 TTL, row absent). Nothing is weakened beyond what the translation requires. RIGHT.
7. H1 numbers: the method is stated (byte-equal string leaves at the same path over all leaves, 1529 per bundle) and reproduces exactly from the base blobs: 362 total (label 196, options 20, pluralLabel 11, help 114, description 11, placeholder 4, emptyState 4, result-dialog 2), label plus options 216; ja-JP 383 / 230 and es-ES 392 / 239 with the stated per-class split. The en and zh-CN bundle blobs are identical across 3cf6449389, b810ddb6f, 851af0c27 and the PR base 3062e500. The card's 338 / 192 matches no variant tried (excluding the bare ID labels gives 339 / 193; excluding `_actions` and `_views` gives 329 / 193); the card states no method, so the PR's finding stands.
8. H4 (help / description / emptyState translated beyond the claim's `label` / `options.*` wording): the extractor files a field's `help` and `placeholder` under source `'field'` (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:1192-1193`), the same class as its label. RIGHT to translate, and the count table records it. Placeholders: none was translated (4 before, 4 after; all four are declared echoes) — see ② for the sentence this falsifies.

Gate verdicts, final read 2026-09-28T18:35:07Z: 34 check-runs, 31 success, 3 skipped (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke — path / opt-in skips), 0 in progress, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates (runs `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) success at 18:31:24Z; Test Core 1/6 – 6/6 success (the package's vitest suite, including the ten ledgers); Type Check workspace / source / consumer / debt-ledger success; Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression 1–3, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Build Core success.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20462-zh-cn-object-labels.md` declares `@objectstack/platform-objects: patch`. RIGHT: the diff changes 320 string values inside a published generated bundle and drops 320 rows from its provenance companion; no export, type, key, schema or API moves, and nothing a consumer's code binds to changes. A copy fix in user-visible text is a patch. The Clause-② line reads `no` in both the PR body and the changeset; right — no forward-compat lever, flag or removal is involved.

Changeset sentences: the title sentence TRUE (the 320 copies are gone; the 42 that remain are declared, as the third bullet says). The symptom sentence TRUE per the card (not re-measured in a browser). "byte copies of the English source that `os i18n extract --fill=default` seeds" TRUE (`--fill=default` is in the root `i18n:extract` script; byte-equal at base). "320 of the 362 … are now translated: labels, plural labels, select options, help, descriptions, placeholders and empty states" TRUE in its numbers, FALSE in its class list: zero placeholders were translated (placeholder 4 to 4; all four are echoes). "`delegated_admin` reads 受托管理员 on both … the word the console already uses" TRUE (objectui zh.ts:2800). "The other 42 stay English by design, each recorded with its reason" TRUE (42 echo rows, each with a departure). The provenance bullet ("regenerated by `pnpm i18n:extract` … now lists exactly those 42") TRUE, measured. "`ja-JP` and `es-ES` are unchanged" TRUE (blobs identical base to head).

PR-body sentences: "Fixes #20462" TRUE. The what-changed bullets (320 / 42 / regenerated / pin / ja-JP and es-ES untouched) TRUE, each measured above; "The 42 are set-equal to the declared echoes" TRUE. The coverage-ratchet paragraph TRUE (baseline untouched; the ledger carries no table ⊆ echoes assertion). The count table: every cell TRUE; "Both bundles have 1529 leaves" TRUE; "byte-identical between 3cf6449389 and b810ddb6f, and this walk reads 362 / 216 at 3cf6449389 too" TRUE; "the card does not state its method" TRUE. "`help` / `description` / `placeholder` / `emptyState` are decided as the same class as `label` … So they were translated too" TRUE for help / description / emptyState, FALSE for placeholder (decided, all four as echoes; none translated). The echo table: every row's leaves, values and reasons TRUE against the bundle (the two Client Secret strings and the term counts were measured directly; the other quoted precedents were not each grepped individually, and the rows are judged right on their own terms). "Where the declaration lives": no keep-source mechanism in `i18n-extract.config.ts` (a plain `defineStack`) or in `os i18n extract` / `check` (only `--filter` and `--fill`) TRUE; the ledger shape TRUE; "`report-dataset-panel-…` is the first" TRUE as the first file, though `undeclaredEchoes` is not in it (nit in ①.4). The terminology bullets TRUE (each precedent found). The collateral section TRUE (floors and messages as described, nine files named correctly, "#20485 edits three of these files in different hunks" TRUE, "A local merge-tree run was not taken" TRUE of the dev; measured here, ③.9). The verification section's local runs are the dev's and are not re-measured here; every CI-declared family is green on the head. The out-of-scope numbers TRUE, measured. The acceptance note on `Locked Until` TRUE.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. Dev open question, the zh-CN word for `delegated_admin`: answered A (受托管理员) by the seat in 5875978969. The diff carries it on both leaves, objectui `zh.ts:2800` uses the same word, and the ledger pins equality across the two objects. Closed.
2. H2 (no keep-source mechanism; the echo ledger used under "or wherever that mechanism lives"): verified as stated; the seat admitted it. Closed.
3. H3 (provenance drift regenerated by `pnpm i18n:extract`): verified generated (digests, order, row set). Closed.
4. H4 (help / description / emptyState translated beyond the claim's `label` / `options.*` wording): the amended claim read the report (Thread-read 5875946281) without objecting; the extractor class is one, the card's Expected names user-facing labels, and the count table records it. Answered: accepted, no escalation.
5. The undeclared widening to the nine ledgers: the seat admitted it, floors only, and the diff holds to that (floor lines, comments, the TTL near-twin). Closed.
6. The first commit amended before its first push (trailer swap): a process note; "The card this PR closes must claim this branch" and the trailer gate are green. No action.
7. Out-of-scope finding (class a, reach: same public door): ja-JP 383 and es-ES 392 copies, with `Delegated Admin` on both `sys_member` and `sys_invitation` in both locales — measured TRUE from the base blobs, and the Invite dialog's role list is served from these bundles. Recommendation: the seat files one follow-up card (or one per locale) with `reach: same public door as the card`, the dev's dedupe words, and the console's existing words as the anchor (objectui `ja.ts` 委任管理者, `es.ts` Administrador delegado). Not a blocker here.
8. The "Locked Until" two renderings: pre-existing on sys_user (锁定至) vs sys_job_queue (锁定到); this PR sides with the identity-side word. Agreed with "noted, not filed": it is one of 33 en values already rendered two ways at base, and this PR adds none. A zh-CN consistency sweep would be its own card if the maintainer wants one.
9. PR #20485 overlap (mergeability): both PRs start from the same blobs of the three files (verified by blob id at 851af0c27 and at #20485's base 9801da123). #20485's hunks sit at lines 665 / 726 (field-panel), 905 (collapsed-sections) and 1137 (lifecycle); this PR's at 557, 770–854 and 1283–1350. A three-way `git merge-file` over each blob triple in scratch exits 0 with no conflict markers: textually mergeable, and the later lander merges `main` per the seat's ruling. Not blocking.
10. Changeset wording: one word overstates ("placeholders" in the translated-class list), and the PR body's "So they were translated too" carries the same slip. Non-blocking; if the branch is re-pushed for any other reason, drop the word.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `927957df4e375e0d7c338d7e63e859335b643d3c`
Local-runs: none

Delta review on top of PASS 5876239898 at `08ebcd01d`. Inputs added, and nothing else: the patch-round-1 os-dev-report 5876378930 on #20462 (the newest there); the edited PR #20490 body, diffed against the body the PASS read; `git diff 08ebcd01d 927957df4`, separated into the round's own commit `4265c40ca` and the merge of `origin/main` `fc0db22bc` (read-only `git fetch`, `git log`, `git diff`, `git rev-parse` on blobs); the check-runs on the new head, read last at 2026-09-28T18:51:38Z. No worktree, checkout, build, test, gate or ablation. Every judgment of the PASS record that this delta does not name carries over unchanged, for the reason ①.1 gives.

### ① Derived judgments

1. The PR's own delta is commit `4265c40ca`: 2 files, +7 / −3. `.changeset/20462-zh-cn-object-labels.md` changes one bullet's class list (the word "placeholders" removed, "and" moved); `objects-zh-cn-echo-decisions.test.ts` changes lines 30–37 of its header comment (+4 comment lines; the file is 324 lines, still 10 `it(` blocks). No other file is in that diff. The bundle `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`, the provenance companion, the nine panel ledgers and the ledger's test bodies are blob-identical at `08ebcd01d`, `4265c40ca` and `927957df4` (verified by blob id for all 13 files). No translated value, assertion or floor moved, so ① items 1–8, ② and ③ 1–9 of the PASS record stand on this head. RIGHT.
2. Correction 1, the changeset class list: "labels, plural labels, select options, help, descriptions and empty states" is TRUE against the base-to-head walk (label 169, options 11, pluralLabel 11, help 114, description 11, emptyState 4, sum 320; placeholder 0). The 42-bullet still names "placeholders that show a value the admin types", TRUE (four echo rows).
3. Correction 2, the ledger header: it now says the table "kept 42 rows, one per echo below (measured equal at the time)", that what is asserted is one direction per verdict (every declared echo still has its row; no pinned translation has one), and that "nothing BEYOND the echoes" is not asserted. TRUE to the letter of the tests: the echo loop asserts `table[objects.path]` equals `hashSource(en)`, the translate check asserts `stillFilled` equals [], and the only size assertion is greater than 0. Comment only; the assertions are byte-unchanged.
4. Correction 3a, the PR body's H4 sentence: "help, description and emptyState were translated, and all four placeholders are declared echoes, because each shows a value the admin types" TRUE (walk: placeholder 4 before, 4 after; the four are the `scopes` / `mapEmail` / `mapName` / `identifierFormat` placeholders, all echo rows with the typed-value departure).
5. Correction 3b, the ledger-history sentence: "`report-dataset-panel-…` is the first: it has `Verdict`, a reason per row and the per-locale departure check written inline. The named `undeclaredEchoes` predicate arrives in the later rounds, first in `object-field-editor-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`." TRUE: `git log -S undeclaredEchoes` over the ledgers directory, oldest first, begins at `576d5df66` (#19418, 2026-09-20), whose diff adds `object-field-editor-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` with the predicate; `report-dataset-panel-` declares `departures` per locale and checks them inline at lines 193–200. The shared clone is not shallow, so the log is complete.
6. The merge: `origin/main` moved `851af0c27` to `811376302` (#20483, build(spec)), `3062e5001` (#20469, fix(core,objectql)!, card #20264) and `fc0db22bc` (#20486, fix(driver-sql)); 21 files changed on main. Their intersection with this PR's 13 files is empty; main's five `.changeset/` files belong to cards 20203, 20240, 20263, 20264 and 20387, and nothing on main touches `platform-objects/src/apps/translations`. At `927957df4`: every PR file equals its `4265c40ca` blob, every main-changed file equals its `fc0db22bc` blob, no file differs from both parents, and `git diff fc0db22bc 927957df4` is exactly the 13 files (+728 / −659). Gate verdicts, final read 2026-09-28T18:51:38Z: 40 check-runs on the head — the body edit at 18:47 re-triggered the PR-metadata workflows, so seven names appear twice — 29 success, 5 skipped (the second Auto Label and Check PR Size runs, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke), 6 in progress, 0 failed. ### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `@objectstack/platform-objects: patch`, the Clause-② line `no`. The delta publishes nothing new (a changelog sentence and a test comment), so the level stands. Changeset sentences: every sentence the PASS marked TRUE is unchanged and still TRUE; the one it marked FALSE now reads "labels, plural labels, select options, help, descriptions and empty states", TRUE. Check Changeset is green on the head.

All three are corrected here, as text only; no translated value, assertion or floor changed." TRUE (①.1). The changeset bullet TRUE. The ledger-header bullet TRUE, including "comment only" and "measured, and deliberately not asserted". The "This body" bullet TRUE (both edits are as diffed). "origin/main fc0db22bc was merged with a true merge commit" TRUE (①.6). "At head 927957df4, `pnpm check:i18n` exited 0 and … `objects-zh-cn-echo-decisions.test.ts` passed 10 of 10" — the dev's local readings, not re-measured here; consistent with the file's 10 tests and with the inputs `check:i18n` reads being byte-unchanged; CI's Lint & Repo Gates is in progress at the final read. "The round-0 gate readings above were taken at 08ebcd01d and were not re-run." TRUE, and consistent with the report's `not_measured`. The os-dev-report's own claims (files_changed two files; line budget 2 files +7 / −3 and 13 files +728 / −659; `git log -S` at 576d5df66, not a shallow clone; fast-forward push to 927957df4; no open questions) each TRUE against the measurements above.

### ③ Boundary flags
